parameters.jsCode:
const state = $('Validate Step Request').first().json;
const previousDecisions = Object.entries(state.decision_state?.steps ?? {}).map(([stepKey, value]) => ({
  step_key: stepKey,
  step_order: Number(value?.step_order ?? 0),
  title: String(value?.title ?? '前一章节'),
  decision_brief: String(value?.decision_brief ?? '').trim(),
  content_available: Boolean(String(value?.reader_chapter ?? '').trim()),
})).filter((item) => item.content_available && item.step_order < state.step_order);
const projectDocuments = (Array.isArray(state.project_context?.documents) ? state.project_context.documents : []).map((item) => ({
  document_id: String(item?.document_id ?? ''),
  title: String(item?.title ?? item?.file_name ?? ''),
  document_role: String(item?.document_role ?? ''),
  status: String(item?.status ?? ''),
})).filter((item) => item.document_id);
const schema = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: { decision_brief: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }, reader_chapter: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 } },
  required: ['decision_brief', 'reader_chapter'],
  additionalProperties: false,
};
const instructions = [
  '为当前分析方向撰写一章可直接发表在项目报告中的中文正文。读者是项目甲方、政府决策者、投资人和非技术评审者。',
  '正文使用普通读者能理解的表达，直接说明判断、依据、候选路径取舍、反证、不确定性和成立条件。内容长度由证据复杂度决定。',
  '本次分析边界是已提供的项目文档、POI、人口、路网、夜光、H3 网格、文献知识库和可按需取得的公开网页。',
  '严格区分事实、代理和未知。未知只降低结论强度，不自动阻塞结论，也不自动生成“必须补齐证据”清单。',
  '先理解 research_brief，再根据判断所需证据自主选择工具；没有相关证据需求时不要为了形式调用工具。',
  '规范原则、研究方法和跨案例机制使用 search_literature_evidence。focused 默认快速返回 PDF 原文；只有确需跨文档综合时使用 synthesis。文献问题必须抽象表达，不得包含未公开项目细节。',
  '最新政策、当地机构和当前公开事实使用 search_public_web 发现来源，再用 fetch_public_web_page 读取准备采用的网页全文；搜索摘要不能作为事实证据。',
  '空间事实只通过 analyze_spatial_evidence 获取。先用 scope 和空 metric_ids 发现指标，再按需选择范围、距离、方向、邻域、排序、关系或个案检查。不得自行重算 GIS 公式或要求完整几何。',
  '项目事实使用 read_project_document 读取原文，返回 complete=false 且结论依赖后文时继续读取。previous_decisions 只是上游阶段判断；需要核对完整论证时使用 read_previous_chapter。',
  '任何工具不可用时不得编造结果；继续使用已取得证据完成尺度相称的条件性判断。',
  '分析关系和机制，检验能否用另一种解释说明同一证据。没有真实取舍时不要强造选项，也不要从代理指标直接跳到因果结论。',
  '优先推进本章新的决策边界，不重复前文，也不提前替后续章节完成核心判断。',
  '成稿前挑战当前判断最脆弱的环节、可能改判的事实及其对下一章节的约束，并写入自由文本 decision_brief。',
  'reader_chapter 是面向甲方的完整正文。只返回 decision_brief 与 reader_chapter，不解释工作流或工具调用过程。',
  '当前研究任务：' + String(state.research_brief || state.step_title) + '。',
].join('\n');
const userPayload = JSON.stringify({
  project_question: state.project_question,
  research_frame: state.research_frame || state.decision_state?.research_frame || '',
  chapter_title: state.step_title,
  research_brief: state.research_brief,
  previous_decisions: previousDecisions,
  project_documents: projectDocuments,
});
const conversationItems = [{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'input_text', text: userPayload }] }];
return [{ json: {
  state,
  instructions,
  input: conversationItems,
  conversation_items: conversationItems,
  max_output_tokens: 5000,
  reasoning: { effort: 'medium' },
  agent_turn: 0,
  parallel_tool_calls: false,
  context_budget_tokens: 24000,
  context_reserve_tokens: 6000,
  no_new_evidence_limit: 2,
  stale_tool_turns: 0,
  tool_call_count: 0,
  tool_result_fingerprints: [],
  tool_evidence: [],
  tool_diagnostics: [],
  tool_error_count: 0,
  tool_error_limit: 2,
  stop_reason: null,
  tools: [
    { type: 'function', name: 'search_literature_evidence', description: 'Search the indexed PDF literature corpus. Use focused for fast original-text evidence and synthesis only for cross-document synthesis. Keep questions free of private project details.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { question: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 2000 }, mode: { type: 'string', enum: ['focused', 'synthesis'] }, top_k: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 10 } }, required: ['question'], additionalProperties: false } },
    { type: 'function', name: 'search_public_web', description: 'Discover current public-web sources. Results are leads only and must be fetched before citation.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { query: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }, provider: { type: 'string', enum: ['anysearch', 'exa'] }, limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 10 } }, required: ['query'], additionalProperties: false } },
    { type: 'function', name: 'fetch_public_web_page', description: 'Fetch full text for selected public-web URLs before using them as evidence.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { urls: { type: 'array', minItems: 1, maxItems: 5, items: { type: 'string', minLength: 8 } }, provider: { type: 'string', enum: ['anysearch', 'exa'] }, max_characters: { type: 'integer', minimum: 500, maximum: 20000 } }, required: ['urls'], additionalProperties: false } },
    { type: 'function', name: 'analyze_spatial_evidence', description: 'Analyze current project spatial evidence through one semantic interface. Use scope with empty metric_ids to discover available metrics.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { analysis: { type: 'string', enum: ['scope', 'distance', 'direction', 'neighborhood', 'rank', 'relationship', 'inspect'] }, metric_ids: { type: 'array', maxItems: 4, items: { type: 'string' } }, selectors: { type: 'array', maxItems: 8, items: { type: 'object', properties: { dimension: { type: 'string', enum: ['poi.category', 'poi.subcategory', 'road.class', 'year'] }, values: { type: 'array', minItems: 1, maxItems: 20, items: { anyOf: [{ type: 'string' }, { type: 'integer' }] } } }, required: ['dimension', 'values'], additionalProperties: false } }, distance_bands_m: { type: 'array', maxItems: 6, items: { type: 'array', minItems: 2, maxItems: 2, items: { type: 'number', minimum: 0 } } }, neighbor_steps: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3 }, rank_order: { type: 'string', enum: ['highest', 'lowest'] }, top_k: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 20 }, record_refs: { type: 'array', maxItems: 20, items: { type: 'string' } } }, required: ['analysis'], additionalProperties: false } },
    { type: 'function', name: 'read_previous_chapter', description: 'Read one completed earlier chapter by step_key or step_order.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { step_key: { type: 'string' }, step_order: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 32 } }, additionalProperties: false } },
    { type: 'function', name: 'read_project_document', description: 'Read verified original text from one first-party project document. Continue with next_start_block until complete is true when the needed claim depends on full context.', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { document_id: { type: 'string' }, start_block: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 }, max_blocks: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 40 }, page_start: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1 }, page_end: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1 } }, required: ['document_id'], additionalProperties: false } },
  ],
  text: { format: { type: 'json_schema', name: 'reader_chapter', strict: true, schema } },
} }];
